# @three-ws/agent-glance

> Put a three.ws agent on any surface that has a slot: home screen widgets, README badges, Slack unfurls, and a live <agent-glance> web component.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/agent-glance/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/agent-glance
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-glance/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-glance/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
